Features

– All our products are made from high quality materials
– Very light to reduce bike weight
– Extremely flexible for eases installation and minimises crash damage
– Made with Avio Fiber for extra durability and reduces weight
– Triple reinforced on all leading edges and mounting points
– Kevlar reinforced on the fixing points – mounting areas
– Oil containment belly pan
– High gloss white gelcoat finish

Includes
Upper Unit, Lower Unit (belly pan), Tail – Seat Unit for OEM/SS seat pad
